title: Fine-tuning in 60 seconds
caption: Fine-tuning in 60 seconds: teaching a trained model a new habit, and when you should reach for it instead of a better prompt. #ai #llm #finetuning

scenes.title: Fine-tuning
scenes.say: Should you fine-tune a model, or just give it better context?
scenes.sub: Should you fine-tune a model, or just give it better context?

scenes.say: A base model has read a huge amount of text. Fine-tuning takes that model and trains it a little more, on your examples.
You show it hundreds of input and output pairs, and it learns the pattern.
It's good at some things and bad at others.

items.title: Habits
items.say: Great for doing one task the same way every time.

items.title: New facts
items.say: Weak for new facts. For those, retrieval works better.

scenes.say: That's fine-tuning. Train it for behaviour, retrieve for knowledge.
